script_text: A cosmic storm is brewing that will redefine your self-image and partnerships this week, Aquarius. On Monday, the Sun in your 6th House of career squares Saturn in your 3rd House, causing frustrating delays in work communications. Tuesday feels sluggish yet reflective. Wednesday transforms as Mercury conjunct Jupiter in your 7th House sparks lucrative deals and love. The key shift arrives Thursday when Uranus, your ruling air planet, trines Pluto in your 1st House, awakening sudden creative breakthroughs in love. The weekend sees Mars enter your 9th House, igniting adventurous learning and travel. Saturday’s Venus sextiles Uranus, delivering exciting surprises to your 5th House romance. Sunday calms with reflective Pluto energy. Wednesday powers your 7th House partnerships via Mercury conjunct Jupiter. Monday is worst as Sun-Saturn square clouds 6th House work. Use your air sign adaptability to negotiate career deals midweek. Follow for daily updates.
